title: Quenched Roasted Portuguese Chicken Roast
description: A light and tender roasted chicken dish featuring the flavors of Portugal, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe is a great twist on traditional roasted chicken.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper, then place it in a roasting pan.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dark soy sauce, olive oil, and garlic. Brush the mixture evenly over the chicken.
Toss the onion, carrot, and celery with a little bit of olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread them around the chicken in the roasting pan.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is roasting, prepare the beurre monte by whipping the heavy cream until it forms stiff peaks, then folding in the grated Parmesan cheese.
To serve, slice the roasted chicken and top it with a dollop of beurre monte and a sprinkle of parsley.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
